U7/U6

Requires:Super Saiyan Grade 4 Power-Up Your mastery of the Super Saiyan form has led you down a path few can ever reach. Your Super Saiyan form has become your base body and rage and unrest are no longer required to use it.

You always appear to be in the Super Saiyan Form, though you are not actually Transformed. You may no longer use the Super Saiyan 1 Transformation or the Grades 2-4 Power-Ups alongside it. You gain 1 Rank of the Light-Weight Condition so long as you are concious. Your Stamina also permanently increases by 2.
